<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>SetNet.Vendor</id>
    <version>1.2.0</version>
    <authors>Artem Lemeshev</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet</projectUrl>
    <description>NPC shops for SetNet: define vendor catalogs (buy/sell prices, currency, stock); clients buy and sell and the server settles atomically through SetNet.Wallet + SetNet.Inventory (money before goods, stock reserved before charge). server.UseVendor(inventory, wallet).Define(...) + client.UseVendor(). Depends on SetNet + SetNet.Inventory + SetNet.Wallet.</description>
    <tags>networking vendor shop economy inventory wallet setnet</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet.git" commit="7cd4d30fc745de4f7cda37604c2328c84a5c7fbc" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1">
        <dependency id="SetNet" version="1.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="SetNet.Inventory" version="1.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="SetNet.Wallet" version="1.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
